trigger.description: Explicit import cass --propose commits source evidence, then one independently reviewed session fails or returns degraded proposals. Later eligible sessions continue; a successful import is not rewritten as a total failure.
setup_commands: # Make one imported session unavailable to review after source import commits; keep another admitted session with a concrete lesson.

message_contains: Other eligible sessions were still reviewed
expected_emission.repair_string: Inspect review.sessions[].error and review.sessions[].degraded; retry the affected sessions with review.sessions[].retryCommand. Candidates require explicit validation and application.
